2.name: Episode 1
2.overview: Michael and Diana have barely arrived in their Spanish happy town when they are dragged back into the fold to answer questions around Ricardo’s death.

2.name: Episode 2
2.overview: After discovering that the person responsible for Ricardo’s death is someone close to him, Michael scrambles for a way to protect them from the consequences – without jeopardising Diana.

2.name: Episode 3
2.overview: Cheryl returns to Liverpool with devastating news for Michael. With no way out, Michael is forced to make an impossible decision to protect the one he loves. Meanwhile, tensions rise among the Phelans as they hunt Banksey, unaware a new enemy is moving in the shadows.

2.name: Episode 4
2.overview: As Michael struggles to maintain control, Ozzie manipulates Freddie down a dark path.

2.name: Episode 5
2.overview: Desperate to recover their losses, the Phelans strike a deal with Ozzie Thompson. At Jamie and Melissa’s engagement party, Michael and Diana attempt to broker peace with the family. Meanwhile, Freddie spirals further out of Michael’s control.

2.name: Episode 6
2.overview: The tragic events of the party send shock waves through the Phelans. As dangerous secrets threaten to come to light, Michael is forced to make a difficult confession to Diana. Meanwhile, unseen dangers close in, and it becomes clear no-one is safe.

2.name: Episode 7
2.overview: As tensions rise between Michael and Diana, Freddie wrestles with his next steps, and the Phelans’ hunger for revenge meets Ozzie’s ultimate betrayal.

2.name: Episode 8
2.overview: As their shared enemy finally comes to light, Michael and the Phelans are forced to come together to survive. Meanwhile, a new trauma opens old wounds, pushing Diana towards a decision that will change everything.

overview: مایکل که سال‌ها در دنیای تبهکاری فعالیت داشته، با آشنایی با دایانا درگیر عشقی تازه می‌شود. این عشق او را به فکر ترک گذشته می‌اندازد، اما ممکن است همان چیزی باشد که همه‌چیز را به خطر می‌اندازد.

seasons.name: Series 2
seasons.overview: After trying to leave a world of crime, Michael is dragged back into the fold to answer questions. Back in Liverpool tensions continue to bubble amongst the remaining members of the gang, and a gangster who's just been let out of prison wants answers.

title: This City Is Ours
